Code & scenery deep-dive

Three frame conventions in one file

sceneryStartFrac 0.495 gives def._sceneryShift measured 0.50943, and K(s) lands at racing frac (s + 0.509) mod 1 (the file's own comment at scenery/imola.js:209-218 states K(0.90) lands at ~0.41; sl(f) :217-218 is the inverse, so K(sl(f)) = f). The file mixes:

  • Racing-frac helpers, no K (land where labelled): forestEdge, grandstandEx, spectatorHill, tieredBowl, terrace, fence, guardrail, tyreWall, along, wall(sl…). measured check: scene() at racing 0.31 lists a 57.5 m stand 16 m left (= grandstandEx(0.28, −1, 14, 56)); at 0.82 a 51 m grandstand 30 m left (= (0.80, −1, 16, 52)).
  • Authored frame via K(s): everything wrapped in K(), plus terrainPatch / riverSurface, which apply K inside (:18-23).
  • Re-keyed via sl(): pit blocks, tower, gantry, Partenza, wordmark, pit wall (:233-262, :374-416, :489) — the only K-wrapped group that lands where intended (measured: tower/garages/gantry visible at frac 0 in frame 01).

The brief (docs/tracks/imola.md §4) and code comments label the K-wrapped items with racing-style positions (river 0.94–0.18, Piratella 0.35, Variante Alta 0.65 …), but they are built half a lap away:

Ranked defects and suggested fixes

Nothing below has been applied. File:line refs are in this tree at the survey sha.

  1. 1 · Santerno river is built half a lap off, and renders as a flat olive slab (HIGH, measured)
    scenery/imola.js:152-169 passes racing-intent fracs (0.94–0.18) to riverSurface/terrainPatch, which wrap K() (:18-23), so the 9 water ribbons + banks land at racing 0.45–0.69 on the +1 side. In frames 04/05/16 (and night 04/05) they show as a large flat lime/olive quad with a hard dark edge, brighter than terrain at night; there is no river at 0–0.18 (frames 01/07/13). Fix: key them sl(s) (or a helper R=f=>K(sl(f))) so K(sl(f)) = f; re-run verify-track and audit (footprint guard may drop patches that now cross the Acque return leg, see :160-163). Why the water material reads flat/unlit is unverified.
  2. 2 · Most K()-wrapped dressing is displaced ~0.509 lap from its brief (HIGH, computed; Senna memorial measured)
    See the deep-dive table: Senna memorial/tribute wall/footbridge sit at ~0.58–0.61 not Tamburello/river; hill villas at 0.86 not Piratella; casali/campanile/vineyards/Variante Alta kerbs/mist/backdrops all shifted. Only sl()-keyed pit/start items and racing-helper calls (stands, forests, fences) are in place. Fix: one pass converting each K(s) to K(sl(s)) for racing-intent numbers (or relabel), checking each against turns[] anchors; verify-track + float/ground audits after.
  3. 3 · Elevation keys applied unshifted: hills in the wrong places (HIGH, measured)
    Road is flat ±0.2 m over 0.40–0.75 while the brief wants Piratella/AM/Variante Alta relief; built +16 m crest at 0.149 (Tamburello), −14 m at 0.31, +14 m at 0.85 (Rivazza, brief says descent), start line 9 m below the 0.15 crest (frames 02, 04, 16, 40). Keys 0.835/0.975/0.135/0.295 + 0.509 = 0.344/0.484/0.644/0.804 match the brief exactly, so they were authored in the scenery frame but consumed raw (tracks.js:105-112, def.js:293). Fix: re-key to 0.344/0.484/0.644/0.804 (arithmetic; confirm with ground-profile), mind the 1.5° bankZones labels (:45-52) which share the frame. Surveyed elevation would be better than 4 cosine bumps.
  4. 4 · Overcast and fog leave the sky saturated blue (MED, measured)
    Overcast frames 37–42 keep frame 01's deep blue; fog (43–48) hazes terrain but not the sky, leaving a haze/sky seam. Storm/rain/wet respond (grey) after the #1979 merge. Fix: js/lighting/atmosphere.js weather blend for overcast/fog zenith (engine).
  5. 5 · Wet-weather ground and SSR artefacts (MED, measured)
    Day rain at 0.33 (frame 27) darkens terrain well below the sky; tarmac reflections are stippled; night-rain 0.33 shows floating white reflection slabs of the Tosa stand; gantry reflection doubles (19/25). Probably shared renderer: renderer-debug.
  6. 6 · Sparse night illumination (MED, measured frames)
    Lamps only on 3 loops (:610-632, ≈26 % of lap), pit/Partenza dark despite lit:true (night frame 01), black sky, terrain black beyond lamp radius; engine lamps off via dressingExclusions (imola.js:30-33). Fix: masts on pit/Partenza and more loops, plus a night horizon term.
  7. 7 · Conifer wall vs deciduous brief (MED, measured)
    Frames 01/05/11: identical layered-cone pines although the brief says broadleaf/"almost no pine"; code pineFrac 0.05–0.25 (:105-149), scene() 139 pines + 1457 trees. Plane/stone-pine/cypress counts are tiny (9/7/38).
  8. 8 · Backdrop mountains are bare pyramids, no horizon haze (LOW, measured) (frames 04/16; :49-63).
  9. 9 · Prop clipping at Tosa (LOW, measured)
    3 severe spots (3.26/1.75/1.24 m, frac 0.339–0.356) from structures.js:808-825 plus 3 coplanar pairs (1.6 mm, fights from 91 m); all at baseline.
  10. 10 · Corner markers verified (INFO)
    Markers for T2–T7, T11–T15, T17–T18 sit on built curvature peaks; T1/T8/T16 gentle (R 383/250/167 m). Built length 0.8 % short of FIA.
